svg.title: Step 12 · Monitoring
svg.desc: Each line the app logs is kept and, once the request has answered, sent to Axiom in one batch within 2 seconds while Vercel keeps the function alive; a line at error goes to Sentry as its exception's class and frames, with nothing private. The health check runs four checks at once, none of which costs, and gives each lane its status from the checks it needs: 200 when every lane that's on works, else 503; the page shows a dot and words beside each lane.
svg.text: Step 12 · Monitoring
Every line kept, every error told, every lane checked: none of it private, none of it costs
Each line, as written
to stdout, Vercel's hour of logs
and kept: 1,000 at most
past that, dropped and counted
Once the request has answered
one batch, NDJSON, within 2 s
wait_until keeps the function alive
a refusal said on stderr, dropped
Axiom
dataset weather-chatbot
each line at its own ts
dashboards, monitors: yours
A line at error, to Sentry too
the exception being handled: its class and frames, else the line's event
tags: event, requestId, lane, tool, check, errorClass, ref · a warning stays a line
no integrations, no message, no request, no variables, no breadcrumbs
Sentry
sent with the lines, 2 s
release: the commit
alerts: yours
/api/health: four checks at once, 8 s each, none of which costs
Open-Meteo: Paris, geocoded, no cache · our MCP server: our four tools offered
Apify's REST door: the account, read · Apify's MCP server: its tools against our pin
a lane works when every check it needs passes; without the token, the lanes with auth are off
200 when every lane that's on works, else 503 · one run a minute per address · the CDN keeps a 200 a minute
a token Apify refuses: AuthError, at error, so Sentry hears of it first
The lane picker: a dot and its words beside each lane
checking… until the page has asked, then every 5 minutes
working
not answering, and still a lane you can pick
status unknown, for an answer the page can't read
Send what you must after answering, never instead of it; check each way out without spending.
Axiom's and Sentry's variables, dashboards and alerts are yours to set: Waiting on you.
